context: NHL regular season (gameType=2). Playoff contexts are registered separately and DISABLED: different OT rules (no shootout, continuous 5v5 OT) and too few games to validate.
horizon: Pregame: features frozen at the scheduled start time; only games that started earlier are used.
validation: Chronological split: train < 2025-12-01, tune 2025-12-01..2026-01-15 (early stopping / AutoGluon tuning_data), select 2026-01-16..2026-02-28 (champion selection, distribution fit, conservative-bound tables; spans the Olympic pause), test >= 2026-03-01 (held out, reported only).

settlement.skater: Stat counts as recorded by the NHL for regulation + overtime. Shootout goals do not count. Player must dress and record a shift (otherwise void).
settlement.goalie: Saves = shots on goal against - goals against for the goalie's own time on ice. Props are evaluated conditional on starting (non-start = void at most books).
settlement.team: Goals include overtime. The shootout winner's +1 counts toward the final score but is not attributed to any skater.

targets.reason: Shot attempts (Corsi) are not in the public boxscore; requires play-by-play ingestion (not yet built).
PP time on ice is not in the boxscore; requires shift charts.

targets.note: Full game incl. OT/SO, home-team rows only to avoid duplicate pairs.
